title: The Twisted Tales of Spike McFang
description: Spike McFang is a linear adventure RPG for the SNES. It was developed by Red Entertainment and published by Naxat in Japan, and by Bullet-Proof Software in the US.  Spike travels through the different cartoon-like isles of Vladamasco, using his cape, his hat (which can be upgraded), and a deck of cards to save his world. Most of the game is spent in battle, collecting coins and experience, but there are a few moments in towns where the player can upgrade Spike's hat and buy new cards. There are few different hats to buy, and the cards are only nominally useful, with a few exceptions. Upon leaving one section of the game it becomes impossible to return, but there is very little exploration to be done. Japanese Version  The Twisted Tales of Spike McFang is known as Chou Makai Taisen! Dorabochan (Super Devil Wars! Dorabochan) in Japan.  The differences between the two versions are small, the most notable would be the scaling of difficulty: the game gets harder as Spike gains levels and his health does not regenerate. Another striking difference is that in order for the game to sell in North America the game was made more family-friendly replacing Spike's hunger for the hearts of his enemies by turning them into adorable garlic clovers and giving spike a thirst for tomatoes and tomato juice.
